name: octomind
title: Octomind
note: a file of its own (mcp-*.toml loads last); bound to the developer:general role
content:
# om: observational memory (om install octomind)
[[mcp.servers]]
name = "om"
type = "stdio"
command = "$OM"
args = ["mcp", "--harness", "$HARNESS"]
auto_bind = ["developer:general"]
